title: Planet Tweaks V3.0.5 NOVA TITAN - 60-Min Integrity Watchdog, Multi-Browser Debloater Suite & Chris Titus Vault
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.0.5 NOVA TITAN: (1) 60-Min & On-Startup Integrity Watchdog: Silently locks MouseDataQueueSize = 0 (Zero-Delay mode) or 16, auto-enforces Windows 6/11 raw 1:1 mouse sensitivity, and scans active tweaks every hour to auto-reapply anything Windows reverts. (2) True Multi-Browser Esports Debloat: Added dedicated Edge, Chrome, and Brave debloaters to purge Copilot, sidebar telemetry, GenAI background daemons, and tracking pings. (3) 18+ Chris Titus WinUtil & Hone/ExitLag Tweaks: Added WPBT OEM firmware bloatware blocker, classic detailed BSOD codes, 1-click End Task on taskbar, 7GB Reserved Storage reclaim, verbose service logon, and precision UTC clock to the Random Tweaks Vault. (4) Clip Compressor Folder Picker Fix: File selection now automatically discovers and defaults to Videos\Planet Tweaks Videos for instant 1-click clip compression. (5) Discord Esports Stream Debloater: Strips Discord overlay, stops GPU rendering lag, and purges shader/GPU cache for smooth 60fps streaming.
